headline: OpenAI's head of computing capacity, Sachin Katti, is leaving the company next month, the Wall Street Journal reports.
score_reason: Pool score 7 kept: a senior exit in the team running OpenAI's largest spending plan, reported by the WSJ.
importance_line: OpenAI's data center partners and investors may see a change in who leads its computing plans, but the reasons for Katti's move are not given beyond his own words.
summary: The Wall Street Journal reports, as relayed by TradingView and BigGo Finance, that Sachin Katti, OpenAI's head of computing capacity, will leave next month after about a year, with 15 Nov given as his last day, and stay on as an adviser. Uday Ruddarraju, who became OpenAI's chief technology officer of computing capacity this summer and is a former executive at xAI, the AI company led by Elon Musk, chief executive of SpaceX and Tesla, will take over computing strategy; Katti has said in a LinkedIn post that he wants to build something new.
notes: WSJ page blocked; text read in two relays. Quartz and CNBC also carry the story but were blocked or empty.
